issues.detail: The Hebrew place name is הַשְּׂעִירָתָה (ha-Se'irathah, 'to Seirah'), but the Vietnamese renders it as 'Xi-e-ra-tha', which appears to be a different name (possibly a transliteration of a different Hebrew form). The expected Vietnamese transliteration would be 'Sê-i-ra' or similar, not 'Xi-e-ra-tha'.
